name: smartgenius
description: Make Instagram posts, carousels and stories for your profiles, and draw images in your brand's style or from any prompt.

interface.longDescription: SmartGenius is a social media manager for Instagram. Ask it for a post, a carousel or a story for one of your profiles, and it plans the slides, writes the text and caption, and draws each image in that profile's voice and visual style. It can also draw images from any prompt. Every post lands as a draft: you approve, schedule or publish it yourself in the SmartGenius studio.
capabilities: Draft Instagram posts, carousels and stories
Draw images in a profile's visual style
Check how many images are left this month
defaultPrompt: Make a carousel about our new menu for my Instagram.
Draw a square image of a coffee cup in my brand's style.
How many images do I have left this month?
